title: Worshiping God
definition: Worshiping God means giving Him the honor, praise, love, obedience, and devotion He alone deserves.
summary: Worship is not limited to songs or gatherings. It includes the whole life offered to God in reverence and love.
christFocus: Christ makes true worship possible by reconciling sinners to God and revealing the Father.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Worship is not limited to songs or gatherings. It includes the whole life offered to God in reverence and love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
